rows.label: Quellor Blueprint
rows.alt: Pyr or Blite Captain on Flexa's Galleon, same table

conditions: The blueprint is a pickup on the boss kill, not an end-of-mission reward; finish the mission once it drops, since aborting throws it away.
Loot abilities (Desecrate, Pilfering Swarm, Prowl, Ore Gaze, Pilfering Strangledome, Retrieve) don't work on these bosses.
In a squad, whoever kills the Galleon captain should wait until everyone is inside before leaving; the interior can vanish for players still outside.
bonuses: Pennant's blueprint rolls separately on the same kill, so you farm both at once.
The pickup is shared: one drop gives the blueprint to the whole squad.
Ivara's sleep arrows or an invisibility frame get you to the boss without clearing the base.

disclosures.title: park the Railjack
disclosures.body: Right after loading in, fly about 8 km away so fighters leave the ship alone, then Slingshot or Archwing over to the base above the fighters. Players report 2-4 minutes per attempt this way; bad luck can stretch past 90 kills.

disclosures.title: other nodes
disclosures.body: Flexa (Veil Proxima) always has a Galleon. Korm's Belt (Earth Proxima) only rolls one some of the time; check the objective list at load-in and relaunch if the boss isn't there.
